label: D2 after a rewarded previous trial, early in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), and only when the previous trial was rewarded (prev_reward==1 covers 100% of mass; never after an unrewarded trial). It is also strongly confined to the first ~40 trials of an episode (rate 9% in trials 0-19, falls to ~0 after trial 60) and to high-value steps (77% of mass in the top value bin), so it looks like a reward-history/early-episode signal at D2. Within those conditions it fires on roughly a third of steps (precision ~0.32); larger activations favour reaching S2 (78% of mass, lift 4x for in_state S2) and choosing a2, and the top windows are often the first a2->S2 trial after a run of rewarded a1 trials. Adding state==2, two consecutive rewards, or a value threshold trades recall for precision without passing F1 ~0.52. Never fires at D1 or GO. Uses only observed variables (ep_trial is elapsed time, not future).
